Stage 10 native R compositional FPCA and scientific diagnostics

etr_native_fpca_extensions.Rd

Python-free functional PCA, reconstruction, component matching, registration sensitivity, eigenvalue gaps and descriptive reporting. Implementations await independent source-equivalence qualification.

Usage

etr_fit_compositional_fpca(trajectories, reference_dimension = -1L,
  epsilon = 1e-8, n_components = 0.95, scaling = "none")
etr_reconstruct_compositional_fpca(result, scores = NULL, n_components = NULL)
etr_component_similarity_matrix(reference, candidate, n_components = NULL)
etr_match_fpca_components(reference, candidate, n_components = NULL)
etr_reconstruction_error_by_curve(result, trajectories, n_components = NULL)
etr_fpca_reconstruction_curve(result, trajectories)
etr_compare_registered_unregistered_fpca(registration, n_components = 3L,
  scaling = "none")
etr_registration_sensitivity_frame(result)
etr_summarise_trajectory_set(trajectories)
etr_summarise_fpca(result)
etr_fpca_reporting_text(result, digits = 1L)
etr_fpca_eigenvalue_gap_table(result, relative_gap_threshold = NULL)
etr_fpca_eigengap_reporting_text(result, relative_gap_threshold = NULL, digits = 3L)
etr_registration_sensitivity_reporting_text(result, digits = 2L)
etr_functional_mean_band_frame(result)

Arguments

trajectories

A native common-grid complete trajectory set, or the fitted original sample for reconstruction diagnostics.

reference_dimension

Zero-based Python-style ALR reference index; -1 selects the last dimension.

epsilon

Positive probability clipping floor in the compositional log ratio.

n_components

Fitted component count; NULL uses all available components. For compositional fitting a variance fraction is also accepted.

scaling

Native FPCA channel scaling method.

result

A compatible native FPCA, compositional FPCA, registration sensitivity or functional mean-band result.

scores

Optional finite replacement FPCA score matrix.

reference

Reference native FPCA fit.

candidate

Candidate native FPCA fit with same grid and dimensions.

registration

Native registered and original trajectories.

digits

Requested reporting decimal places, integer from 0 to 15.

relative_gap_threshold

Optional pre-specified descriptive near-tie threshold in [0,1).

Value

Numeric array, matrix, component-matching list, diagnostic data frame, reporting text or native compositional FPCA result, according to the function.

Details

Exact native maximum-weight component matching uses the historical subset dynamic program for up to 12 components and an exact cubic-time Hungarian assignment for larger fitted bases. Both optimize the absolute integrated component similarity; tied optimum permutations need not agree with SciPy tie choices. Diagnostic frames do not supply inferential guarantees. Scientific full-source and 508-export independent contract qualification remain pending.
